name: Retired Fid

intro.text: I wintered at Base A in the fifties. Never did get the hang of the cooker. Never did get the hang of anything, but the dogs. Show me what you've got.

win: Cold fingers, old brain. I should have retired decades ago. I did. I just didn't leave.
after: They gave us two tins of peaches a week. Two. I still count my peaches.
